005package org.wpilib.math.controller;
006
007import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
008
009import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Pose2d;
010import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation2d;
011import org.wpilib.math.kinematics.ChassisVelocities;
012import org.wpilib.math.linalg.DARE;
013import org.wpilib.math.linalg.MatBuilder;
014import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Matrix;
015import org.wpilib.math.linalg.VecBuilder;
016import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Vector;
017import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N2;
018import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N3;
019import org.wpilib.math.system.Discretization;
020import org.wpilib.math.trajectory.HolonomicSample;
021import org.wpilib.math.util.Nat;
022import org.wpilib.math.util.StateSpaceUtil;
023
024/**
025 * The linear time-varying unicycle controller has a similar form to the LQR, but the model used to
026 * compute the controller gain is the nonlinear unicycle model linearized around the drivetrain's
027 * current state.
028 */
029public class LTVUnicycleController {
030  // LQR cost matrices
031  private Matrix<N3, N3> m_Q;
032  private Matrix<N2, N2> m_R;
033
034  private final double m_dt;
035
036  private Pose2d m_poseError = Pose2d.ZERO;
037  private Pose2d m_poseTolerance = new Pose2d(0.05, 0.05, new Rotation2d(0.05));
038  private boolean m_enabled = true;
039
040  /**
041   * Constructs a linear time-varying unicycle controller with default maximum desired error
042   * tolerances of (x = 0.0625 m, y = 0.125 m, heading = 2 rad), default maximum desired control
043   * effort of (linear velocity = 1 m/s, angular velocity = 2 rad/s), and default maximum Velocity
044   * of 9 m/s.
045   *
046   * @param dt Discretization timestep in seconds.
047   */
048  public LTVUnicycleController(double dt) {
049    this(VecBuilder.fill(0.0625, 0.125, 2.0), VecBuilder.fill(1.0, 2.0), dt);
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Constructs a linear time-varying unicycle controller.
054   *
055   * <p>See <a
056   * href="https://docs.wpilib.org/en/stable/docs/software/advanced-controls/state-space/state-space-intro.html#lqr-tuning">https://docs.wpilib.org/en/stable/docs/software/advanced-controls/state-space/state-space-intro.html#lqr-tuning</a>
057   * for how to select the tolerances.
058   *
059   * <p>The default maximum Velocity is 9 m/s.
060   *
061   * @param qelems The maximum desired error tolerance for each state (x, y, heading).
062   * @param relems The maximum desired control effort for each input (linear velocity, angular
063   *     velocity).
064   * @param dt Discretization timestep in seconds.
065   */
066  public LTVUnicycleController(Vector<N3> qelems, Vector<N2> relems, double dt) {
067    requireNonNullParam(qelems, "qelems", "LTVUnicycleController");
068    requireNonNullParam(relems, "relems", "LTVUnicycleController");
069    m_Q = StateSpaceUtil.costMatrix(qelems);
070    m_R = StateSpaceUtil.costMatrix(relems);
071    m_dt = dt;
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * Returns true if the pose error is within tolerance of the reference.
076   *
077   * @return True if the pose error is within tolerance of the reference.
078   */
079  public boolean atReference() {
080    if (m_poseError == null || m_poseTolerance == null) {
081      return false;
082    }
083
084    final var eTranslate = m_poseError.getTranslation();
085    final var eRotate = m_poseError.getRotation();
086    final var tolTranslate = m_poseTolerance.getTranslation();
087    final var tolRotate = m_poseTolerance.getRotation();
088    return Math.abs(eTranslate.getX()) < tolTranslate.getX()
089        && Math.abs(eTranslate.getY()) < tolTranslate.getY()
090        && Math.abs(eRotate.getRadians()) < tolRotate.getRadians();
091  }
092
093  /**
094   * Sets the pose error which is considered tolerable for use with atReference().
095   *
096   * <p>The default tolerance is (x = 0.05 m, y = 0.05 m, heading = 0.05 rad).
097   *
098   * @param poseTolerance Pose error which is tolerable.
099   */
100  public void setTolerance(Pose2d poseTolerance) {
101    m_poseTolerance = poseTolerance;
102  }
103
104  /**
105   * Returns the linear and angular velocity outputs of the LTV controller.
106   *
107   * <p>The reference pose, linear velocity, and angular velocity should come from a drivetrain
108   * trajectory.
109   *
110   * @param currentPose The current pose.
111   * @param poseRef The desired pose.
112   * @param linearVelocityRef The desired linear velocity in meters per second.
113   * @param angularVelocityRef The desired angular velocity in radians per second.
114   * @return The linear and angular velocity outputs of the LTV controller.
115   */
116  public ChassisVelocities calculate(
117      Pose2d currentPose, Pose2d poseRef, double linearVelocityRef, double angularVelocityRef) {
118    if (currentPose == null || poseRef == null) {
119      return new ChassisVelocities(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
120    }
121
122    // See theorem 8.8.1 of
123    // https://file.tavsys.net/control/controls-engineering-in-frc.pdf
124
125    if (!m_enabled) {
126      return new ChassisVelocities(linearVelocityRef, 0.0, angularVelocityRef);
127    }
128
129    m_poseError = poseRef.relativeTo(currentPose);
130
131    // spotless:off
132    final double τ = 20.0;
133    var A = MatBuilder.fill(Nat.N3(), Nat.N3(),
134        0.0, 0.0, 0.0,
135        0.0, -1 / τ, linearVelocityRef,
136        0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
137    var B = MatBuilder.fill(Nat.N3(), Nat.N2(),
138        1.0, 0.0,
139        0.0, 0.0,
140        0.0, 1.0);
141    // spotless:on
142
143    var discABPair = Discretization.discretizeAB(A, B, m_dt);
144    var discA = discABPair.getFirst();
145    var discB = discABPair.getSecond();
146
147    var S = DARE.dareNoPrecond(discA, discB, m_Q, m_R);
148
149    // K = (BᵀSB + R)⁻¹BᵀSA
150    var K =
151        discB
152            .transpose()
153            .times(S)
154            .times(discB)
155            .plus(m_R)
156            .solve(discB.transpose().times(S).times(discA));
157
158    var e =
159        MatBuilder.fill(
160            Nat.N3(),
161            Nat.N1(),
162            m_poseError.getX(),
163            m_poseError.getY(),
164            m_poseError.getRotation().getRadians());
165    var u = K.times(e);
166
167    return new ChassisVelocities(
168        linearVelocityRef + u.get(0, 0), 0.0, angularVelocityRef + u.get(1, 0));
169  }
170
171  /**
172   * Returns the next output of the LTV controller.
173   *
174   * <p>The reference pose, linear velocity, and angular velocity should come from a drivetrain
175   * trajectory.
176   *
177   * @param currentPose The current pose.
178   * @param desiredState The desired pose, linear velocity, and angular velocity from a trajectory.
179   * @return The linear and angular velocity outputs of the LTV controller.
180   */
181  public ChassisVelocities calculate(Pose2d currentPose, HolonomicSample desiredState) {
182    if (currentPose == null
183        || desiredState == null
184        || desiredState.pose == null
185        || desiredState.velocity == null) {
186      return new ChassisVelocities(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
187    }
188
189    // The sample velocity is field-relative; the controller needs the
190    // robot-relative forward (linear) velocity.
191    double linearVelocity =
192        desiredState.velocity.toRobotRelative(desiredState.pose.getRotation()).vx;
193    return calculate(currentPose, desiredState.pose, linearVelocity, desiredState.velocity.omega);
194  }
195
196  /**
197   * Enables and disables the controller for troubleshooting purposes.
198   *
199   * @param enabled If the controller is enabled or not.
200   */
201  public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
202    m_enabled = enabled;
203  }
204}
